goal: Produce a local-CSV-only Markdown report of grade×region cross-tab (row count + mean reading_score) from offline_data/students.csv, identify max/min mean cells with sample sizes, annotate every key number with its source, and save the report to disk with its absolute path returned.

plan.title: Load CSV & compute cross-tab stats: Read offline_data/students.csv; group by (grade, region) for G10/G11/G12 × A/B/C/D; for each cell compute row count and mean(reading_score); identify the max-mean and min-mean cells with their sample sizes; save the full cross-tab (including per-cell n and mean) to offline_data/grade_region_cross_tab.csv

Write Markdown report with source annotations: Using offline_data/grade_region_cross_tab.csv, write a Markdown report saved to disk (e.g. offline_data/grade_region_reading_report.md) containing: (a) a level-1 title, (b) at least one data table of all 12 cells with n and mean(reading_score), (c) every key number annotated inline as '（来源：offline_data/students.csv 的 reading_score，按 grade×region 分组，n=<行数>）' or '（来源：由前述两行计算）' for derived ratios, (d) a concluding paragraph naming the highest- and lowest-mean cells with their sample sizes. No web data. Return the absolute file path in the final reply
